experiment: mask-and-reconstruct validation of torso-reference linear interpolation

reliabilityDefinition.conditions: Dog detected; torso reference present and positive length; both shoulder and both hip coordinates and raw scores present; all four raw scores >= threshold.

method.oneFrame: For each eligible reliable frame, hide its torso reference and linearly estimate it from the immediate reliable frame before and after.
method.twoFrames: For each eligible non-overlapping pair of reliable frames, hide both references and interpolate between the immediate reliable frames before and after.

groundTruthClarification: All reported errors compare interpolation estimates with the original RTMPose-derived torso references. These are AI-prediction-to-AI-prediction validation errors, not errors against manually verified ground truth; no manual labels are present in the experiment data.
